finalists.label: Angiosarcoma
finalists.why: Strong evidence from biopsy and histopathology findings, including dermis permeated by irregular, slitlike spaces containing erythrocytes and cells staining positively with CD31.

finalists.label: Malignant Hemangioendothelioma
finalists.why: Similar evidence to Angiosarcoma, with a 30 × 25-cm centrally eroded purpuric plaque and dermis permeated by irregular, slitlike spaces containing erythrocytes.

finalists.label: angioma
finalists.why: Shared evidence with Angiosarcoma, including a 30 × 25-cm centrally eroded purpuric plaque and dermis permeated by irregular, slitlike spaces containing erythrocytes, but less specific.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen due to its strong and specific evidence from biopsy and histopathology findings, including cells staining positively with CD31 and negative for CK5, which is not shared with the runner-up.

Cells stained positively with CD31 and were negative for CK5
